apps.localizedDescription: Husk runs Android apps and games, and PlayStation 4 games, on iPhone. Its Translation Layer runs games made with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Flutter, cocos2d-x, SDL and more natively, a full Android system is there for everything else, and its PS4 layer plays fake packages and game folders (iOS 17.4+). Husk needs JIT: StikDebug, its built-in StikJIT, TrollStore or a jailbreak.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Husk 3.3
Play without JIT converts more games (one failed library no longer stops the rest). Java apps get further: jobs, boot receivers, Wi-Fi and location. The in-app file picker can be used more than once. Certificate import from SideStore/AltStore and .p12 matches Feather's empty-password handling.

## Husk 3.2.1
Fixes importing the signing certificate from SideStore/AltStore and from a .p12 file (Play without JIT).

## Welcome to Husk 3.0.
The biggest Husk release yet: a new console-style look, PlayStation 4 games, and hundreds more Android games.
## A new Husk
- Console-style home screen and a new library
- Light and dark mode
- An iOS-style setup on your first 3.0 launch
## PlayStation 4 games (iOS 17.4+, JIT)
- Add fake packages (.pkg) or game folders with the + button
- Tested: Bloodborne, Minecraft PS4 Edition, Sonic Mania
- Shaders kept between launches
## Android
- 366 newly working games (488 working in all), see antiweb.lol
- Unofficial ports: Sonic Robo Blast 2, Ring Racers, NetHack, PokeWilds, Unciv
- Flutter, Godot 4 and Python games
## Also
- Reports can attach your Husk log
- Runs on iOS 15.5 and later
- Lots of fixes
## Known issues
- Bloodborne runs, but well below full speed
## Links:
- Discord: https://discord.gg/xApMHWAzkh
- X Profile: https://x.com/leviidev01
- Compatibility list: https://antiweb.lol

## Welcome to Husk 2.0.
I’ve been working hard over the past few days, and I’m glad to say, Husk 2.0 is out! You’ll enjoy it, a lot.

## New App Support
- Over 150+ games and apps, now running on Husk.
## Notes:
Thank you all for the continuous support, It’s been a good few months, and I’m just amazed at how big Husk got. Thank you so much, and enjoy Husk 2.0. There is more to come.

## Info
Husk's first stable release (1.0.0), is right around the corner. It will probably be the best release, fixing issues for almost all devices, but it is not out yet. This IPA may not work, and that is ok. It will be fixed soon, just open a GitHub issue

## Notes:
